notes.title: Update 87 - New Features and Steam Remote Play Together!
notes.content:
[b]Update 87 - New Features and Steam Remote Play Together![/b]

(July 4rd - Oct 21, 2019)

[h1][b]BAG News! [/b][/h1]
We're back with a new post! Whew, it's been too long. It's time we come up for a breath of air and show you things we've been working on for the next build. Also, the release notes are up to date with over 320 new fixes, additions and changes! :)

Topics
1. Build a Game Features
2. Steam Remote Play is here


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24983209/d76662cb029a90d4ff0199efbd0c3529a461db6f.png[/img]


[h1][b]Tile Features[/b][/h1]
[b]+ Tile Type Mover - New![/b]
Control tiles in directions with a moving walkway tile. 

+ Objects pushed on to mover
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24983209/a69026efaa3d55c29ea1855eee2eee8970ef207b.gif[/img]

+ Player on mover
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24983209/bc8fc0012097d4bb16a929056c5cf90dd6bf1f56.gif[/img]

+ Player on an upward mover
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24983209/05ace206441f59fa62691969217d397d4b105223.gif[/img]


[b]Tile Type Terrain - Updated![/b]
The terrain tile system is updated to work faster and smarter while you build.

+ Terrain auto shapes
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24983209/61bb24b3a717319b6c5565c0aeb62528641c65a9.gif[/img]

+ Terrain shape scaling
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24983209/dfde6d0267f2e2d3effb665d3f79f1aac4f70fd3.gif[/img]

+ Terrain fill and edge mode now separated for precision
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24983209/54c3bcd465f17ad64bddf164b9e79d2d5880a32a.gif[/img]

+ Terrain edge color
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24983209/02222c23ec845bfcda9d9dacbd6beaa3b25aaeef.gif[/img]

+ Terrain fill color
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24983209/ff3e6dfab6554c4b6b7e1e57fd6aedfba5f660bd.gif[/img]

+ Node type corner
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24983209/59a7d8138b1ea25950d02b98419041589ef77d7d.gif[/img] 

+ Node type curve
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24983209/46fa3f8731572464ba10dd9bb6223eb12f6f4273.gif[/img]

+ Node type edge
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24983209/350dfb46e4ede3d62784b746c1de4954ad4c3532.gif[/img]

+ Eyedropper tool works for copy/paste on any terrain
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24983209/9aeac12717ec478239c3c1a3fcf055f669eefb40.gif[/img]


[b]Tile Type Volume - Distortion effect![/b]

+ Distortion effect on volume
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24983209/b866598c6b5ecb93c3e7a154e2d1df89d07176c2.gif[/img]

+ Player being visually effected by distortion
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24983209/6ff5e0e4fe25a9faa8a5458932cbead7eb5f1767.gif[/img]


[b]Snaps! In Editor - New![/b]
The snap option provides a quick mode for placing tiles on to different surfaces, in all directions.

+ Enable settings
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24983209/f8bb8c675a20409bc93aa9bcc8a6eb302860b6c7.gif[/img]

+ Snap position and rotation
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24983209/fc3e77f1580d185b8784e0615cc5ff11bf006594.gif[/img]

+ Snap after moving
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24983209/1fe682d5e25a266a6f6ad1cb42d9363742c860f4.gif[/img]

+ Snap, stack tiles
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24983209/0fd3aca547854a6693a874d5745c1a8674a68247.gif[/img]


[b]Additional Tile Feature Updates[/b]
+ Added player random idles [i](Up to 4 variations)[/i]
+ Added player on die stop camera tracking
+ Added player jump/move dash distance options for users
+ Added player on die explosion torque [i](rotation)[/i]
+ Added player on dead move to new position with tweening
+ Added story commands for trigger events [i](/trigger, wait, id (1-5))[/i]
+ Added new options for background tile scaling [i](separate amounts per bkg)[/i]
+ Added new tiletypes to Default Standard Tileset
+ Added hotkey (key: 7) for the amount of fade on layers
+ Added weapon charge up states to player ai systems
+ Added weapon extras (muzzleflash, hit spark, hit end, etc) control on scale
+ Added sphere collision to Parenting objects options
+ And much more [i](Check out the release notes)[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24983209/d76662cb029a90d4ff0199efbd0c3529a461db6f.png[/img]


[h1][b]STEAM REMOTE PLAY[/b][/h1]
That means you can build and play Build A Game Universe with your friends online right now! 
We've already tested it out and it's awesome! :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24983209/9b43ea875ef47f6e39f7857583eb8bdab7b8da04.png[/img]

Full details [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/593110/announcements/detail/3032537193879549687]here.[/url]

Here's how to get things working.

1. Join Steam Beta ([url=https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=7021-eiah-8669]instructions[/url])

2. Launch Build a Game Universe.

3. Invite your friends.
From your Friends list in the Steam Overlay, select Remote Play Together. Once they accept...

4. You're playing together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24983209/9f42009d15a776268595069af830ad445849aaf2.gif[/img]

Their controllers will act as if they're plugged directly into your computer, and all your voice chat and game volume options are available in one place.

To keep things simple, only the game is displayed to your Friends, never your desktop or other Top Secret stuff. You can share — or limit access to — the keyboard and mouse. It’s your choice.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24983209/d76662cb029a90d4ff0199efbd0c3529a461db6f.png[/img]


[h1][b]Training Videos[/b][/h1]
Don't forget, we have training videos available for those wanting to learn how to use Build a Game.
[url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCg7N8PikaTgl5Mp-nHTZVuw/playlists?view=1&flow=grid][b]1025+ videos[/b][/url] are available for learning Build a Game! 
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DjAo-VlapdE&list=PLTLXTizBX5u_We1zVCBpyQg7YxJT-dCP2&ytbChannel=null][b]116 videos[/b][/url] are available for learning Tile Builder!


[h1][b]Our Silver Standard Reminder [i](Silver Coin Allowance)![/i][/b][/h1]
During the beta program, you will receive 1,000 silver coins into your account each week. Have fun purchasing games and tiles!


[h1][b]Beta Group Signup[/b][/h1]
Sign up for the Beta. Email steamkeyplease@buildagameuniverse.com to get your steam key and be a part of the testing. =) 


If you play on Steam Remote, let us know how your experience goes in the comments. :)

[h1]Thanks![/h1]
Chad - Nathan - Eric

(May 7th - July 3rd, 2019)

[h1][b]Summer update! [/b][/h1]
New tile, more features and bug fixes in Build a Game Universe!

[b]Tile Updates[/b]
[b]+ Tile Type Wavy - NEW![/b]
The Wavy tile allows the user an easy way to create a flag or banner blowing in the wind.
- Banner type
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/7ce0b0c5bde1007776f1525fd56a6654530cff74.gif[/img]
- Wave by trigger
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/bce851073da17b935f24b9ad0699b3284a85ffe8.gif[/img]
- Flag style
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/88b9864196d671cd9ac1082a7a7b1b8a77607753.gif[/img]

[b]+ Camera Type Blur - NEW![/b]
The blur camera type provides a simple option for enabling motion blur to any camera.
- Blur example
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/9e1ee63032d26df6db013d1082c0a1f922170fe7.gif[/img]

[b]+ See-Through Option[/b]
For tiles that you want to see behind other objects, we've rolled out the first version of the see-through mode with multiple configurations and options.
- Step 1. Enable tiles you want to 'see-through'
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/785c9417143ffd271485648593502db625b6c954.gif[/img]
- Step 2. Enable tiles that can be seen
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/67ab663c6585bee430ccfb828b12ed23750d7ed5.gif[/img]

[b]+ Image Effect Glow Options[/b]
The image tile has glow options available for adjusting and camera specific options to render to.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/5cef3d344c7ddf0a8a5e201e0d5c8065bdfd4e68.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/66c156735a6884ef445c05f4df6791dc2ce8d961.png[/img]

+ Added on die explosion position - Choose where a tile explodes from
+ Added text option for player holding breath in volume (water) through the gui
+ Added distance checking options for dash (move,jump) attacks
+ Added an auto reset rotation option for player using match angle and gravity faux
+ Added a toggle option for fade level in editor mode between layers (hotkey '7')
+ Added x,y options for independent background tile scaling
+ Added accuracy checking system for layer depths

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/66c156735a6884ef445c05f4df6791dc2ce8d961.png[/img]

When working with tiles, they can be used in multiple ways. 
For example, the screen transition tile can use the event trigger to check for the player on die and respawn.

- Setup for the event trigger
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/0a292274a603bfa3fe2d181c24518a2b9fb6dd22.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/66c156735a6884ef445c05f4df6791dc2ce8d961.png[/img]

Have fun creating with Build a Game Universe!

notes.title: Update 84 - Timeline Tile and Tutorial!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Update 84 - Timeline Tile and Tutorial![/b][/h1]

(March 28th - April 23, 2019)

[h1][b]Introduction to Timeline![/b][/h1]
We want to take time to walk you through the features available in the Timeline Tile [i](Tutorial style)[/i]. [url=https://drive.google.com/open?id=1ZQbWn19jQ6bpX3wp1zQwzWFLwSnApSm1]Documentation is available here[/url].

[b]Timeline Structure[/b]
The timeline tile provides an easy way to add story context to your game! 
The structure of a timeline looks like the image below. A [b]director [/b]tile [i](controls the start and general elements of an event)[/i]. The [b]clips [/b]are individual actions [i](ie. movie bars animate in, or play an animation sequence, etc)[/i]. The [b]props [/b]provide a series of images and audio clips to use during the timeline event.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/bb93cb70731f43b58c7cefb3858e24b82cf0b67f.png[/img]

With the [b]Director[/b], you can have it trigger the event to start. Each [b]Director [/b]has an id to tell corresponding [b]Clips [/b]to begin. The [b]Clips [/b]run in numeric order and once all clips are complete, the event is ended.

Let's take a look at the setup and several of the timeline clip actions available:

Step 1: Using the Default Tileset, you can put the director and two clip tiles in to the scene. Then enable the Director (gif example).
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/3a7e6a524da5e651eea7a5692d5259844fff5a08.gif[/img]

Step 2: Activate the first clip.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/e683b805f6f68c9098afc1a228af75bffbf752c7.gif[/img]

Step 3: Set the movie bars to 'show' when activated.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/e78a655604b9f3c3e3d230e542e56b60206d03a8.gif[/img]

Step 4. Activate the second clip. 
Be sure the id for the clip is changed to 1, that way it happens after the clip 0.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/506c74adce90c4b5121448def8f67b833dbb6a88.gif[/img]

Step 5. Now we can hide the movie bars after a slight delay.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/66b5a5894d09ef401589f36dee08585acad53740.gif[/img]

Step 6. Press play and walk the player into the tile to see the event happen.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/22d0b820d8719faae374bd541d2489c582df85d5.gif[/img]

Step 7. Camera Zooming. With timeline, you can control the camera features directly as things happen. This example sets the camera to zoom out, then back in on completion.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/3d6f6adfb18fa43cec3ed557c10ddcb0c0554910.gif[/img]

Step 8. Actor Setup and Fade. Any tile can be enabled as an actor for the timeline.
+ Enable an Actor
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/9138fb8e11efd33a767ad1009e3a5d49a89225d4.gif[/img]
+Fade Setup
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/7ec3285ddcea374528e4ded63cb7240d727ffb92.gif[/img]

Step 9. Gui Elements. When going in to a cutscene, hiding/moving gui offscreen is common. Set gui as an actor and the timeline auto toggles its state.
+ Gui Setup
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/35c9042270141c66789faf19ca8785dfa9ff9d6e.gif[/img]
+ Gui moving on / off screen
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/494738f80bf6afe0790c2ee6e179a7677dcff960.gif[/img]


[b]Timeline Editor[/b]
The editor is an input field with some fun features added. You can type your story directly in to it, and/or use an external tool [i](notepad++, etc)[/i] and copy/paste it in to the box.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/190defa38f86a5aecb553dcf34d652fae4dd7f4d.png[/img]


[b]Timeline Editor Menu[/b]
While we're looking at the editor, here's a quick look at the extended tools.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/74463d86e664c802c595ce97fa4895f898fb1946.png[/img]
1 - [b]Play [/b]: Test out what you've written instantly.
2 - [b]Continue [/b]: Make changes and continue where you left off.
3 - [b]Word [/b]: Available words you can type and templates to start with.
4 - [b]Copy [/b]: Click to copy the current text to the clipboard.
5 - [b]Paste [/b]: Click to paste the clipboard text in to the current text.
6 - [b]Font Type [/b]: Click to cycle through font type.
7 - [b]Text Size [/b]:  Display size of text in editor.
8 - [b]Font Color [/b]: Color for editor text.
9 - [b]Editor Layout [/b]: Six layout options for the panel.
10 - [b]Panel Alpha [/b]: Level of transparency for editor panel.
11 - [b]Panel Color [/b]: Color of editor panel.
12 - [b]Toggle Tools [/b]: Show full and compact mode.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/66c156735a6884ef445c05f4df6791dc2ce8d961.png[/img]

[b]Writing Your First Story[/b]
Let's jump in to writing! To have text appear on the screen we can use several different options. Our first option is to tell Timeline which box to type in.

[b]~centerbox[/b]

And then we can align the text to a position. For this example we'll put it in the center of the screen using: aligncc [i](Note: We separate each parameter with a comma ',')[/i]

[b]~centerbox, aligncc[/b]

Then we use the colon : to let the story know we're ready to type our message.

[b]~centerbox, aligncc: Hi there[/b]

Now you're ready to press the play button to test it out. :)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/f9ce3e2141c063968fc91b46dec2d3e026f88f60.gif[/img]

[b]Extra: [/b]
If you want to change the color of the font, type in:
[b]~centerbox, aligncc, color = red: Hi there[/b]

[b]Extra, Extra: [/b]
Want to add an icon into the text? Try this:
[b]~centerbox, aligncc, color = red: Hi there <icon = icon1>[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/66c156735a6884ef445c05f4df6791dc2ce8d961.png[/img]

[b]Introduction to Flags and their Functions[/b]

Flags and their functions
~ Speaking
@ Name and speaking
# Picture
+ Increment
! If statement
> Run
/ Command

In total, there are about 700 keywords provided for the flags. :)

A line has 3 sections:
[b]Flag[/b]
The first character of the line, that is not a letter or a number (example: “@” is a flag). When looking up the flag, white spaces at the beginning of the line are omitted. If the line does start with a letter, then the default “~” flag is assigned. The flag is used to invoke different methods, for example the flag “#” will trigger the “picture” method, which will change an image element of the UI.

[b]Properties[/b]
Any number of phrases, words, numbers etc. separated by a comma, located between the flag and a colon. While all white spaces count, a single space after the comma is omitted for clarity. Arguments are used by all methods differently. ~ -flag doesn't have arguments and the whole line (ex. Flag) is used as a message.

[b]Message[/b]
Everything that comes after the colon. All white spaces after the colon and at the end of the line are cleared. Messages are used by all methods differently.

[b]Word Samples[/b]
Click on the 'W' button and choose Templates to see a full list of examples.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/fa4fcfd609dfc53ca537be8d3fe2c0d8f6b16e8d.gif[/img]

And that concludes the overview and tutorial on getting started with the Timeline tile. This week we'll post full videos walking you through all the elements in greater detail. Thank you!


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/66c156735a6884ef445c05f4df6791dc2ce8d961.png[/img]


[h1][b]Training Videos[/b][/h1]
Don't forget, we have training videos available for those wanting to learn how to use Build a Game.
[url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCg7N8PikaTgl5Mp-nHTZVuw/playlists?view=1&flow=grid][b]1025+ videos[/b][/url] are available for learning Build a Game! 
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DjAo-VlapdE&list=PLTLXTizBX5u_We1zVCBpyQg7YxJT-dCP2&ytbChannel=null][b]116 videos[/b][/url] are available for learning Tile Builder!


[h1][b]Our Silver Standard Reminder [i](Silver Coin Allowance)![/i][/b][/h1]
During the beta program, you will receive 1,000 silver coins into your account each week. Have fun purchasing games and tiles!


[h1][b]Beta Group Signup[/b][/h1]
Sign up for the Beta. Email steamkeyplease@buildagameuniverse.com to get your steam key and be a part of the testing. =) 


Have fun testing out the Timeline tile in Build a Game Universe!

[h1]Thanks![/h1]
Chad - Nathan - Eric

[h1][b]Update 82 - Feature Updates![/b][/h1]

(December 4th - January 31st, 2019)

[h1][b]Welcome back![/b][/h1]
We hope your new year is off to a great start!

For us, it's been a month of development:
1) Bug fixing and polishing systems.
2) Expanding tile type features.
3) Launch Title Game[i] (wip).[/i]

In this update, we'll look at new features and fixes in the Build a Game Universe! :)

[h1][b]Features First.[/b][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/9487db6fafb0f07ae782a46e95dbe8321e25cb40.png[/img]

During development of the weapon and projectile system, we needed to add in a few more core elements to capture the fun of weapon designing. With the latest build, we introduce two main elements to the mix -> Hit Effect Behaviors and Multi Input Types.

[b]1) Bullet Hit Effect Behaviors[/b] 
+ When the bullet hits an object, it can apply behavioral changes. Currently, supported types are scale, physics, pause, and follow.

[b]On Hit Behavior - Scale[/b]
+ Scale changes an objects size on hit. For example, the primary fire can grow the object while the secondary fire can shrink it. Each has the ability to auto-return to its original size after a set time.

+ Grow and Shrink 1
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/4b9921bcab816bc6f327c916f538f6f9a8e3d40b.gif[/img]

+ Grow and Shrink 2
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/976b52c00bcd3c97ef2011fc6f90bb26c64aba22.gif[/img]

[b]On Hit Behavior - Physics[/b]
+ After a hit occurs, the physics will transform the hit tile in to a physics object and have it fall, and optionally have a reset based on time or distance.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/7faa02d6e5889a116e6de41c4825d3342e75722d.gif[/img]

+ Gravity On [i](Primary)[/i], Off [i](Secondary)[/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/08e66fb5e6b04c8558eabb576a470286e5fac57d.gif[/img]

[b]On Hit Behavior - Pause[/b]
+ When pause is enabled, it will freeze the tile in place for an amount of time and optionally reset it after. Simulates an ice gun or freeze ray. :)
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/fe5280aa14d67ff15be764bc2d21f84f6c15db60.gif[/img]

[b]On Hit Behavior - Follow[/b]
Follow provides a friendly way to activate an object to follow and repel.
+ Follow and repel
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/3045581f1f95bc3c22e1a1349cfc8944b25c2b65.gif[/img]

+ Follow [i](Primary) [/i]Stop [i](Secondary)[/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/b01728e6e246778da722e0d8f947b7a5fa62acc1.gif[/img]

+ Repel only
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/3fbdb3c5d4202fb2d0434495e3de618fd4ab5a62.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/66c156735a6884ef445c05f4df6791dc2ce8d961.png[/img]


[b]2) Multi Input Types[/b]
The Multi Input Types provide a second layer of behavior to each bullet when shot. 
[b]Old way[/b] -> Single operation -> Press button to fire, bullet flies through air until hitting a tile.
[b]New Way[/b] -> Multiple input -> Press button to fire, optional button to apply new behavior to the bullet.

[u]The system has three core parts.[/u]

+ [b]Select how [/b]->  On Hit (default), On Button Pressed, After Time Delay, After Distance.
+ [b]Select type [/b]-> Detonator, Gravity Gun, Change Angle, Change Gravity, and Steer.
+ [b]Select input [/b]-> Shoot and Activate with Primary, Secondary, and both.

+ On Button Pressed -> Shoot Bullet to Hit Tile -> Detonator -> On Hit -> Enable on Button Pressed
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/6b4e140b7301e831ea39f44c00ac8e001f6435cb.gif[/img]

+ On Button Pressed -> Shoot Bullet -> Gravity Gun [i](Tool)[/i] Holds Tile -> Press to Throw
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/8a5a50edcb19b17d783446372992c46e2c66c6c6.gif[/img]

+ On Button Pressed -> Shoot - In Air - Press Button to Change Bullet Direction
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/65618e460d218a44989d1ea8f78f375135ac2d80.gif[/img]

+ On Button Pressed -> Shoot - In Air - Press Button to Add Gravity to Bullet [i](Drops)[/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/db66f00c6d2f902ac86aa1b68fabf520f33798ad.gif[/img]

+ On Button Pressed -> Shoot - In Air - Joystick 2 Steers the Bullet till hit
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/e72d275ef82a5ca15239a244dd712ece2f9b1b2d.gif[/img]

+ On Button Pressed -> Shoot - In Air - Fuel Count Down
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/b0bf4646f5dba378fcc830b61c6038f70189c023.gif[/img]

+ On Hit -> When Distance After Tile Hit Reached
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/319bd73865d1b04af920fbeec2f717874094f7e5.gif[/img]

+ On Hit -> When Time After Tile Hit Reached
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/21849f122aaadcbc96c2d62e4284bd7b00e1fed5.gif[/img]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/66c156735a6884ef445c05f4df6791dc2ce8d961.png[/img]


[b]Spawn and Coin Loot[/b]
+ Coin Spawning and Removing
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/862af856003ba0df9ff48bebb0c4d3b5a4d7c54a.gif[/img]

+ Multi Spawn Type Based on State
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/492156794b5344a154bba4cd196be5af46549fca.gif[/img]

+ On Die Spawn [i](Heart)[/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/89cb6239adcc48ac8d62c94fa436e284872917c6.gif[/img]

+ On Hit Spawn Water and Coin
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/2f31452d0a800a6665e29362926966c6530479ba.gif[/img]

+ Mix of Spawn and Pickup Behavior Changes
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/651d87ad952cf261f5d414be404453adc135a6a5.gif[/img]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/66c156735a6884ef445c05f4df6791dc2ce8d961.png[/img]


[b]Camera Bob[/b]
The camera bob system was reworked to provide a smoother hand-held style of motion. With three options of activation - Idle, Move, and Always.

+ Camera Hand-Held Style During Idle
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/8a23b09d3026f05ea5db73b6a796720dbdb481f1.gif[/img]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/66c156735a6884ef445c05f4df6791dc2ce8d961.png[/img]


[b]UI Highlighter Update[/b]
+ UI Ripple Effect provides an extra layer of feedback
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/ad1eeb90c46f6f75e15619eefd1e210f1f38b981.gif[/img]

[b]Fonts[/b]
+ Over 250 new fonts added to the text options!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/988e4395288b21153d864de4275c489dabfb553d.gif[/img]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/66c156735a6884ef445c05f4df6791dc2ce8d961.png[/img]


[b]!--IMPORTANT--![/b]
[h1][b]Pickup will need fixed-up.[/b][/h1]
+ This update requires property changes to any level containing a pickup tile type [i](coins, hearts, health, etc).[/i] Please follow the steps below [i](or video)[/i] to update your pickup tile type in games and tilesets. 

Steps to make it work.
1) Select the tile to get to properties
2) Select the Item button (icon/rollout)
3) Enable as Item -> True
4) Item Type -> Consumable

tags.feature: + When the bullet hits an object, it can apply behavioral changes. Currently, supported types are scale, physics, pause, and follow.

+ Scale changes an objects size on hit. For example, the primary fire can grow the object while the secondary fire can shrink it. Each has the ability to auto-return to its original size after a set time.
+ After a hit occurs, the physics will transform the hit tile in to a physics object and have it fall, and optionally have a reset based on time or distance.
+ When pause is enabled, it will freeze the tile in place for an amount of time and optionally reset it after. Simulates an ice gun or freeze ray. :)
Follow provides a friendly way to activate an object to follow and repel.
The Multi Input Types provide a second layer of behavior to each bullet when shot.
+ Coin Spawning and Removing
+ Multi Spawn Type Based on State
+ On Die Spawn (Heart)
+ On Hit Spawn Water and Coin
+ Mix of Spawn and Pickup Behavior Changes
The camera bob system was reworked to provide a smoother hand-held style of motion. With three options of activation - Idle, Move, and Always.

notes.title: Update 79 - New Build!
notes.content:
[b]Update 79 - New Build![/b]

(September 15th - October 24th, 2018)

A new build of [b]Build a Game Universe[/b] is live! Yea!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/45636e1983221b1f81804ba64f7d8cbae31332c5.png[/img]

Are you new to [b]Build a Game Universe[/b]? Request your key [i](free)[/i] today and start playing with all the new features! [i](steamkeyplease@buildagameuniverse.com)[/i]


[b]First.[/b]
This update represents the past several months of work on Build a Game Universe. We have eight major areas to cover [i](changes, revisions, additions)[/i] and [i](for those following along)[/i] it combines updates from the last few months to help keep things organized. :)

1. Main Menu
2. Market Center
3. Product Page
4. Editor Mode
5. Tile Types
6. Tilesets [i](tiles)[/i]
7. Tile Builder
8. Performance Upgrades


You can dive in to the categories below and/or jump straight in to Build a Game to see the changes yourself. Let us know if you have any questions. [b]Have fun![/b]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/66c156735a6884ef445c05f4df6791dc2ce8d961.png[/img]


[b]1) Main Menu.[/b]

+ Learn Modes
Framework has been established for four different learning types. Quick intro, classroom, manual, and video. As we move forward [i](lots to do)[/i], we'll continue to refine and polish these based on feedback and testing.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/eb5c078746bfd18af563bbb93edae56e9b4858c4.gif[/img]


+ Refresh Button
The refresh button on the main menu page [i](lower left)[/i] is the beta way of insuring you can 'refresh' tiles and products in case they don't appear in your market and development.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/6e451d76eed61ec17eefcc0c5713d3599c176c95.png[/img]


+ Settings Menu [i](Highlighter)[/i]
A new highlighter is available for the user. It allows active UI to show a border line, inside fill and optional color when selected. Settings menu will soon include all editor side options as well.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/3cf88e993954f70a5cb5700010ba9dfc7eece356.png[/img]


+ Onscreen Keyboard
The onscreen keyboard [i](joystick and touch mode)[/i] provides a clean grid pattern for easier navigation.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/98d3a97b360f4cb956d0a2c75cbc3cf500bd0ed4.gif[/img]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/66c156735a6884ef445c05f4df6791dc2ce8d961.png[/img]


[b]2) Market Center.[/b]

The Market Center [i](continuing goals)[/i] are to provide a fresh and fun experience while exploring the games and tilesets in the Build a Game Universe.

+ Layouts and Grids
Added optional view types which included small and large sizing, and added a list, grid and column type view.

+ List View [i](New Design)[/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/f03ce900af8da9fdcd1edeae9987f5809c25d366.gif[/img]

+ Switchable views [i](List, Column, Grid)[/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/68875a4576b5b20063f71c679fe3af683f81bd67.gif[/img]

+ Product View Sizes[i] (Small/Large)[/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/0a017a1402d3bcce74421027145ab35a802ae875.gif[/img]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/66c156735a6884ef445c05f4df6791dc2ce8d961.png[/img]


[b]3) Product Page.[/b]

+ New to the product page is the ability to assign a unique background image to your product. The background fits for any screen-size and defaults at 1920x300 pixels. Examples can be found in the [url=http://www.buildagameuniverse.com/download/]Default Tileset[/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/06d69da21a24b0140df23ba1547ca379f106c3a1.gif[/img]

+ Public and Private Modes[i](plus coming soon - gameID's for quick sharing)[/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/0cbe9f7ad3751971b735774eb75b62cd9e78b254.gif[/img]

+ Gallery System [i](carousel)[/i]
Set youtube video links and screenshot images to your games.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/1b8bff6d40f8980928059b1379e7b7deb19d1986.png[/img]

+ The carousel viewer provides two viewing modes [i](fullscreen and halfsize)[/i] 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/70fb2436bb3d60ecaadf54d7a6900f346972e66c.gif[/img]

+ Video player controls [i](close up)[/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/a0eb1789420400dce90710adc47d4160cdab6a31.png[/img]

+ Gallery viewing example
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/a555000e04a7471fedf06b6fb6e183f64be47921.gif[/img]

+ QA Section
The core testing of levels is currently disabled so that we can implement a much larger [i](and fun)[/i] system for quality assurance on games. The end goal is to help increase developer quality and meet a higher level of expectation  from the end user. In place of QA, the developer will verify their game is playable and meets the user guidelines each time they publish, by clicking on the message prompt for [b]Publisher Agreement[/b].


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/66c156735a6884ef445c05f4df6791dc2ce8d961.png[/img]


[b]4) Editor Mode.[/b]

+ Toolbar tools
Let's point out a few buttons you may enjoy clicking on in the editor. :)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/ccf2a0f00f173fdcda912d77c25dc5d2ccfac3e9.png[/img]
[b]1)[/b] Home (0,0) - Takes you back to the origin point in the scene.
[b]2)[/b] Quick Map and Go - Click to zoom out to scene extents, then click to zoom back in.
[b]3)[/b] Save Scene - Allows you to save while you work (Hotkey - Ctrl+S)
[b]4)[/b] Video Player - In editor - watch or follow the training videos while you  build.
[b]5)[/b] Tile Selection - List style view for selecting and moving to a tile.

Example of Tile Selection Viewer
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/3e910d1ef990f7b13234903eb21721dcd6b7d4f3.gif[/img]


+ Tile Connections
Building levels then coming back to them after a day [i](or two)[/i] can present a challenge in remembering what tile is connected to what. Our first goal in assisting with that challenge is to connect the dots. Any tile that connects with another has the option of viewing it's connection.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/a89f9539e74da8fb1e5b73c31fc045e8e4cff6b5.gif[/img]

Optional Line Images
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/4177f95d11924a7e1c9340faba4ad468e9ba9e03.gif[/img]

Animating the Line Direction
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/fc1aa6417a6333c08743fcd05e86c8d6486eb5df.gif[/img]

Multi-tile Connection
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/02fd6dd9711b97964cb0ba1f8c87bd26aa11fe0f.gif[/img]


+ Trigger Events
The Trigger Event system in Build a Game is prepared for testing. We'll release additional videos on complex designing this month. For now, it would be great to see how everyone handles the basics [i](and help in finding bugs, polishing flow and function).[/i] Thank you!
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HaSFGlxKEuA]1) Trigger Event: Basics[/url]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ml8xLI0aIQM&t=1s]2) Trigger Event: Screen Transition[/url]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=o15lVxJ5hiw]3) Trigger Event: Change Player State[/url]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kf_o3bvzhoo]4) Trigger Event: Change Mover Direction[/url]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CuARJEDQKqk]5) Trigger Event: Adjust Scribble Brush Size[/url]


+ Slider bar input
The input buttons [i](by click)[/i] will allow you to change the value directly [i](without sliding/dragging)[/i].
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/ae44a0d6c76ec852ff7297c84f17e2b3640c8fc8.gif[/img]

Multiple input selection and adjustment
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/67a516f2560e8bd39fae1021bc4aa6a0270a3151.gif[/img]

+ Disabled Tile Save Type (None, Remember-Me, Persistent) for tiles. We are refactoring it's core purpose alongside the QA section. Will be released in a future beta build.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/66c156735a6884ef445c05f4df6791dc2ce8d961.png[/img]


[b]5) Tile Types.[/b]
The new tile types are listed below with one example for each. Next week we'll post training videos covering all their cool features and how to use them. :)

+ Teleportation Item - Ability to teleport player a set distance
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/a8f4c0aeb933f26b2616cd2fb7a2d7c755ccf27a.gif[/img]

+ Offscreen Indicator - Tracks any tile using an icon (on/off screen)
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/b2a77339fe8bb6a32b4231ef32afdffa4be252f4.gif[/img]

+ Waypoints - Point path system for tiles to follow
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/f1d411fe866cd7a293397f7de118ac6b0683f1db.gif[/img]

+ Gui - Added a popup message system and pause option (user side)
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/b64ad0740d9665a4679f5b14f1c2246d718014e3.gif[/img]

+ Music Match - Pattern making system to match by click
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/d9b9ca89d2778b9f9bd61cc7e0b85e9aa0fb312c.gif[/img]

+ Dissolver - Create smooth fades to reveal and hide parts of your scene
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/a3a4dcba8f71d5d4163b4f1cf90ea8b69379bc1d.gif[/img]

+ Dissolver - Direction and gradient type
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/6bae97edec59a9f03c4e00589cc343599e1bdc2c.gif[/img]

+ Dissolver - Edge blending for effects
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/e4eea014ed930a7bedc87b74fa95087e28f36f07.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/5fd2eb79aa1f63f657dafe82efdcda337caa99d4.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/66c156735a6884ef445c05f4df6791dc2ce8d961.png[/img]


[b]6) Tilesets.[/b]

Available now, 25+ tilesets ready for testing.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/a5454801473ff5fb3dcd2253fe32232e0bd8b2ee.png[/img]

[b]Special Note:[/b] For all developers that have submitted content to the Market Center, you can now re-submit to get things back up. :) No changes are needed, simply open the tileset project in Tile Builder, click Submit, then when you are ready, make it Public in Build a Game. 
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8sxXO3Muui0&list=PLTLXTizBX5u9jCRDA7GnlvZAG5eMOVjFa]Check out the full process here[/url]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/66c156735a6884ef445c05f4df6791dc2ce8d961.png[/img]


[b]7)Tile Builder.[/b]

We've added two options [i](buttons)[/i] in Tile Builder for improving the workflow and speed of making tiles between tilesets.

[b]Exporting a Project[/b]
Have a tileset project? Wish you could use that one as a starter project for other tilesets? You can!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/41ec9133e3a7d899cceb50993460804f614a594c.png[/img]

1. Bottom left corner you'll see four buttons. Click on the disc with the green arrow.
2. Create a folder or navigate to an existing one.
3. Click the 'Export Project' button.
4. Done.

That's all there is to it. Now you have a full copy of the project to use for a new starter project. When you open it up, you can replace [i](Right click on tiles and replace images)[/i] tiles and already have all your properties completed. Yea!

Check out the video example to see how quick and easy it is. :)
[url=https://drive.google.com/open?id=1osrYljhNs9EOBv7280TI3986wDaTe_b0][b]Exporting a Tile Builder Project[/b][/url]


[b]Template Loading and Saving[/b]
Templates allow you to Save and Apply tile properties within different projects (tilesets). Meaning -> You spent hours on a player tile and want to apply those same values to another tileset player. Now you can. :)

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/93d681b215de5517b8fa23924dbaa7881db485a1.png[/img]

1. Open Project'A'. (Any project you want)
2. Right click on a Tile. Select the [b]Save as Template[/b] option.
3. Give it a name when prompted (Ex. Player Tile - Dog 1 )
4. Open Project'B'. (Any project you want - or use it in the project you already have opened)
5. Right click on a Tile. Select the [b]Apply Template[/b] option.
6. Select the template you want to apply. Tile Builder will automatically assign it to the selected tile.

Here's a simple video showing how to do it :)
[url=https://drive.google.com/open?id=1AHl5Utg6snTagrdoutA8lI9xpSGqbll4][b]Template Saving and Applying Explained[/b][/url]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/66c156735a6884ef445c05f4df6791dc2ce8d961.png[/img]


[b]8) Performance Upgrades.[/b]

The past few months we've continued to focus testing on mobile and consoles, mainly in key areas for speed and size improvement.
+ Loading into Build a Game happens immediately.
+ Going into the level editor loads much faster with intelligent tileset checking.
+ RAM usage is significantly less in multiple areas, namely loading and unloading of tiles.

If you have been using Build a Game for awhile, then you are most likely going to notice a huge speed increase on loading [i](in all areas)[/i]. :)


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/66c156735a6884ef445c05f4df6791dc2ce8d961.png[/img]


[b]Training Videos[/b]
Don't forget, we have training videos available for those wanting to learn how to use Build a Game.
[url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCg7N8PikaTgl5Mp-nHTZVuw/playlists?view=1&flow=grid][b]1025+ videos[/b][/url] are available for learning Build a Game! 
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DjAo-VlapdE&list=PLTLXTizBX5u_We1zVCBpyQg7YxJT-dCP2&ytbChannel=null][b]116 videos[/b][/url] are available for learning Tile Builder!


[b]Our Silver Standard Reminder [i](Silver Coin Allowance)![/i][/b]
During the beta program, you will receive 1,000 silver coins into your account each week. Have fun purchasing games and tiles!


[b]Beta Group Signup[/b]
Sign up for the Beta. Email steamkeyplease@buildagameuniverse.com to get your steam key and be a part of the testing. =) 


Remember, this update means we have cleared the store front and servers [i](Fresh Start)[/i]. If you have any questions or concerns, just let us know (support@BuildaGameUniverse.com). Thank you!

Time to Build a Game with us and fill up the store with fun!
Thanks!
Chad - Nathan - Eric

[b]Update 75 - July News[/b]

(June 10th - July 20th, 2018)

We're back with more updates on [b]Build a Game Universe[/b]!

First.
[b]Updates[/b]
+ Lot's of fun things on the business side pulling together and prep work for our next build update!
+ This might be the longest quiet time on record - [i](Let's not do that again)[/i]
+ And it's the longest non-pushed-up-changes on record. [i](Fixing that next month)[/i]
+ Things are about to change. :)


Second.
[b]Features![/b]
A [b]Music Notes[/b] tile type and new [b]Play[/b] system are coming!
Music notes tile provides an enjoyable memory skill play system with options [i](and audio, not in gif)[/i].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/d9b9ca89d2778b9f9bd61cc7e0b85e9aa0fb312c.gif[/img]


[b]Play Tile System[/b]
Something fun to come!
The Music Note tile is the introduction to the 'play' system. Well, actually 'Player Tile' was, but think of these as mini-games [i](or a complete game)[/i], which have adjustable rules to play with. 
Play tiles will include an array of games like checkers, chess, cards (regular, black jack, freecell), match 3, memory match, connect four, hangman, pong, tennis, puzzles, and much more. notes.title: Update 74 - Coming Attractions!
notes.content:
[b]Update 74 - Coming Attractions![/b]

(May 5th - June 10th, 2018)

We're back with more updates on [b]Build a Game Universe[/b]!


First.
[b]Updates[/b]
With a month of work complete, we are overdue for an update! 
Here's a quick overview.
+ Bugs -> Over 350 commits, revisions and fixes last month.
+ Features -> 10 new features and updates [i](below)[/i].
+ 26 gifs showcasing new bag things!
+ Market Center reset is still on the todo list.
+ New Tile -> Offscreen Indicator!

With that said, let's jump to the features!

Second.
[b]Features![/b]

+ Editor Tile List Tool
The tile list tool provides quick access and navigation to all tiles in the scene.

[b]Update 73 - Performance, Optimizations and the Market Center[/b]

First.
[b]Updates[/b]
+ Three weeks of work on performance, polish, and bugs. [i](More on that below)[/i]

+ Next week, we demo the [b]Teleportation[/b] tile, which has some awesome, fun features and mechanics.


Second.
[b]Performance Gains![/b]
The last few weeks major testing has been done on mobile and console.
With that said, we focused on key areas for improvement.
+ Loading into Build a Game happens immediately. 
+ Going into the level editor loads much faster with intelligent tileset checking.
+ RAM usage is significantly less in multiple areas, namely loading and unloading of tiles.

[b]Important![/b]
Overall, file load/save/use is 1/3 the original size, which means Build a Game works on mobile devices, consoles, and lower end computers.

+ Let you know the timeframe.
+ Then clear (delete) Games and Tilesets from the store.

The [b]Beta Testers[/b][i](You)[/i]
+ Submit your Tilesets to the store again.[i](This will update them to the new system)[/i]

[b]Games[/b][i](Everybody)[/i]
+ The optimizations are breaking changes for all games. 
+ Once we update, old games will no longer work.

Note: 
In previous updates, the changes were small, however with the new improvements to Build a Game, it requires a fresh start.

notes.content:
[b]Update 70 - New Tileset![/b]

(March 9th - March 16th, 2018)

First.
[b]Updates[/b]
Great things happened last week! But, nothing we can show and tell...yet. :\ When it's finished (1-2 weeks), we'll be sure to make a big deal of it in a news update. :) In other news, we have an excellent new tileset coming to the Market Center [i](this weekend)[/i] and a spotlight feature on Image Effects [i](below)[/i]. :)


Second.
[b]Tileset![/b]
Combat Joe Platformer Pixel! That's right, it's time to put some soldiers in the playing field. :) Joe is a 2D side-scrolling, platform jumping soldier with fun weapons that make a big impact on the tiles! [b]Tileset will be available this weekend[/b].

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/e4962843a42464e804df9c057d2cacdd3b5e3a22.png[/img]



+ Third
[b]Tile Spotlight -> Image Effects - LUT![/b]
This week we're checking out a great feature in Image Effects -> LUT.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/baf5e92d9706a7ca790016a44c7251a57c4dd972.png[/img]

When working on a game with different tilesets, they don't all 'sync' together sometimes. With LUT, it allows you to 'blend' the colors to have a matching game.

>> How does LUT work?
Think of it like a math problem: R = S + L
[b]R[/b] is your result or what you want to get
[b]S[/b] is your source or what you start with
[b]L[/b] is your LUT [i](difference needed to make up between your source and your desired outcome)[/i]

Let's pose the question.
>> How do I make all my tilesets [b]blend[/b] together? [i](Image below needs some help)[/i]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/e37783321126d4598728fb86ef2cdf2e3cf254e4.png[/img]

Let's walk through an example of correcting this image.

1. For starters, we need the Image Effects tile. [i](Available in the Default tileset)[/i]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/d09f881c5be62cdea219bd4043e3319aed89ac76.png[/img]

2. In the tile properties, you can adjust the LUT type which will result in different blending modes. Here is an example.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/47595266f8ef07223cea681a8524564847b4bce9.png[/img]

3. Also, you can adjust the [b]Blend Value[/b] (and others) to control the final output.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/74b87010fe8fd60f57a2b55679d1115c1d262a7a.png[/img]

4. For this example, I've selected LUT Texture Id: 73 and 75
ID: 73
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/cf31f3a197e6dfc9ad5dc8aa8b8a55813145e526.png[/img]
ID: 75
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/c51742625a3f2c0cd8a18bcd3c5758cee044837d.png[/img]

+ Third
[b]Tile Builder Tips![/b]
Two tips this week for using Tile Builder!

[b]Exporting a Project[/b]
Have a tileset project? Wish you could use that one as a starter project for other tilesets? You can!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/41ec9133e3a7d899cceb50993460804f614a594c.png[/img]

1. Bottom left corner you'll see four buttons. Click on the disc with the green arrow.
2. Create a folder or navigate to an existing one.
3. Click the 'Export Project' button.
4. Done.

That's all there is to it. Now you have a full copy of the project to use for a new starter project. When you open it up, you can replace [i](Right click on tiles and replace images)[/i] tiles and already have all your properties completed. Yea!

Check out the video example to see how quick and easy it is. :)
[url=https://drive.google.com/open?id=1osrYljhNs9EOBv7280TI3986wDaTe_b0][b]Exporting a Tile Builder Project[/b][/url]


[b]Template Loading and Saving[/b]
Templates allow you to Save and Apply tile properties within different projects (tilesets). Meaning -> You spent hours on a player tile and want to apply those same values to another tileset player. Now you can. :)

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/93d681b215de5517b8fa23924dbaa7881db485a1.png[/img]

1. Open Project'A'. (Any project you want)
2. Right click on a Tile. Select the [b]Save as Template[/b] option.
3. Give it a name when prompted (Ex. Player Tile - Dog 1 )
4. Open Project'B'. (Any project you want - or use it in the project you already have opened)
5. Right click on a Tile. Select the [b]Apply Template[/b] option.
6. Select the template you want to apply. Tile Builder will automatically assign it to the selected tile.

Here's a simple video showing how to do it :)
[url=https://drive.google.com/open?id=1AHl5Utg6snTagrdoutA8lI9xpSGqbll4][b]Template Saving and Applying Explained[/b][/url]



[b]Tile Spotlight -> Spawn on Die[/b]
This week we're going to take a moment to review the spawn properties available in most tiles. If it's your first time spawning tiles, be sure and check out the video links [i](below)[/i].

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/9f209cf9b1c34eb6c5441fa82897fcefa1ff5ee9.gif[/img]

Spawn On Die - When a tiles health reaches the minimum amount (0), the tile goes in to a spawn item stage. Meaning, when a tile dies, you can have it provide loot -> a coin, a pickup, and even a ladder. :)

[b]Example Videos[/b]
[url=https://drive.google.com/open?id=1795snekv8UPJ3TMnwKhgBrx_UIjUmBKt][b]Spawn a coin![/b][/url]

notes.title: Week 60 - Gui Tile Extended
notes.content:
[b]Week 60 - Gui Tile Extended[/b]

(November 16th - 22nd, 2017)

Next on the list [i](and still in the works)[/i] is gui. At its core, the design is to make gui an enjoyable experience for the developer and user. :) Let's take a look at some new features!


[b]Gui Tile[/b] [i](Feature Updates)[/i]
[b]Overview[/b]
+ Gui Ids
  - can now track each other with out connected brushes
  - provide an auto connected gui system

[b]+ Gui Navigation[/b]
  - allows id ordering for moving and selecting each gui tile
  - provides quick logic for last selected and smart movement
  - controlled by mouse, keyboard, joystick, and touch

Navigation with joystick
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/76d0b948062034964a3d74f1f2125aa692d420d6.gif[/img]

[b]+ Gui Receivers[/b]
  - create actions [i](toggle, movement, etc)[/i] with all gui tiles
  - item tiles can now directly call gui receivers [i](videos below)[/i]
  - gui receivers display data [i](image and text info)[/i] from other tiles

On Click Receivers move off-screen and fade
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/dd1199cc73e3fb85a5864a2118b1fc1a9e99f683.gif[/img]

On Pickup Receiver moves up on-screen [i](toggle)[/i] message box
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/2a4def55693682162bb315ece366035518b89635.gif[/img]

On Pickup Receiver moves left to right on-screen [i](toggle)[/i] message box
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/960e43f2357e94e6554fe1736cdaf0d8c830e051.gif[/img]

[b]+ Gui Connector[/b]
  - combines multiple gui tiles into a single action
  - connects gui tiles, receivers and actions into a single click

Toggle all gui states within a group, with connectors
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/c3850d2b2b0395918ba4b3647f48daefff3645e3.gif[/img]


[b]Final Note.[/b]
We have another week+ of gui development. The [b]todo list[/b] looks like this:
- Scrolling and scrollbar connections
- Lock/Unlock selection
- Carousel selection
- Click Actions[i] (ex. load, save, next, previous)[/i]

Thanks for following along!

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DjAo-VlapdE&list=PLTLXTizBX5u_We1zVCBpyQg7YxJT-dCP2&ytbChannel=null][b]116 videos[/b][/url] are available for learning Tile Builder!

During the beta program, you will receive 1,000 silver coins into your account each week. Have fun purchasing games and tiles!


[b]Beta Group Signup[/b]
Sign up for the Beta. Email steamkeyplease@buildagameuniverse.com to get your steam key and be a part of the testing. =)

notes.content:
[b]Week 51-52 - New tile, new tileset, new features and more[/b]

(September 14th - September 25th, 2017)

It's been two weeks of fun! New tile type, new tileset, updates on the [b]Image Editor[/b], and we are putting the final touches on [b]Tile Builder[/b] beta. Whew! Exciting times. :)


[b]Tileset Pixel Backgrounds[/b][i](part 1)[/i]
23 pixel background images are headed to the market this week for testing.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/061b081c9577f14b1a8e5d6738b889fedf5f465b.gif[/img]

[b]Tileset Pixel Backgrounds[/b][i](part 2)[/i]
Be sure to look for the tileset this week in the Market Center.


[b]Builder tile - create/remove 'effects'[/b]
Added effect options for the create and remove elements of the Builder tile type.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/e509d7c5579f8ef4cea08ea70b5a168ef4d762ea.gif[/img]


The [b]Image Editor[/b] [i](sprite editor)[/i] is getting worked on!

Build a Game [b]'Universe'[/b] is a full suite of tools for you [i](the developer)[/i]. The latest tool we mentioned [i](last time)[/i] was the [b]Image Editor[/b]. A big goal we have for the [b]Image Editor[/b] is to provide a 2d drawing, painting, and animating solution that can replace the other 2d painting and pixel editing tools on the market [i](for free)[/i].

With that said, below are a few features we're highlighting this week.

[b]Image Editor: Layers[/b]
The layer panel provides an easy way to paint on different layers, move layers up/down, and develop in a traditional digital way.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/6d9fd220dba3dc304264e1f023a9574b39130a9a.gif[/img]

[b]Image Editor: Animation Clips[/b]
The animation clips [i](video goes a little fast)[/i], are setup to create the animation directly in the scene with any number of layers per animation clip. You can view the animation with the Animation Preview window.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/1cf022d4d2ff3ee70719952345f7e03c3ce6bdb1.gif[/img]

[b]Image Editor: Printing[/b]
Printing - Added last week in to the [b]Image Editor[/b]. Now you can easily print out your drawings!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24983209/17ae03d820cfef715208ad016a9ef5dc8aede770.gif[/img]

After writing up a brief bit about the [b]Image Editor[/b], it makes me think we should dive in deep to the fun features. We'll look to do an article on just the [b]Image Editor[/b] next month!


[b]Training Videos[/b]
This week, we have on our list to work up videos for all the new tiles and features that have been added. Also, there are [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCg7N8PikaTgl5Mp-nHTZVuw/playlists][b]820+ Videos[/b][/url] currently available for learning Build a Game!


[b]Our Silver Standard Reminder [i](Silver Coin Allowance)![/i][/b]
During the beta program, you will receive 1,000 silver coins into your account each week. Have fun purchasing games and tiles!


[b]Beta Group Signup[/b]
Sign up for the Beta. Email steamkeyplease@buildagameuniverse.com to get your steam key and be a part of the testing. =) 


Have a great week with Build a Game!
Thank you!
Chad - Nathan - Eric

notes.content:
[b]Week 25 - Spawner and Transition[/b]

(March 1st - 7th, 2017)

Another great week of development on Build a Game Universe!
Highlights from the week include a new tile, new features and new videos. Check it out below. :)

notes.title: Week 12 - One Thing Leads To Another
notes.content:
Week 12 - One thing leads to another

(November 22th - 28th, 2016) 

This is just a quick update before the week is gone. :)

Have you ever started down a certain path (Player tile) and then realized 1.5 weeks later that you spent nearly the whole time on a different path (Goal/Manager tiles). :) But that's okay! Now player (and tiles) communicate smoother with goals for their win/lose/tie conditions!

Player is still being polished, while goal and manager tiles have become super cool! We should have videos showcasing all the new features next week. 

Here's a highlight of the extended goal system for Build a Game. 
- Any tile can be a goal contributor (ex. pickup items)
- Win states
- Lose states
- Tie state
- Co-op mode (win/lose)
- Verses mode (win/lose)
- Instant win/lose options
- Time mode (can be single or part of a set of goals)
- Goals can also check for: score/points, health, and lives across any tile
- Each goal can have multiple states for win/lose
- Goal tiles can be combined (using Tile Manager) for any number of goal options

We look forward to showing you all the fun new things in Build a Game, next week!
Thank you!
Chad - Nathan - Eric

(November 22th - 28th, 2016) 

This is just a quick update before the week is gone. :)

Have you ever started down a certain path (Player tile) and then realized 1.5 weeks later that you spent nearly the whole time on a different path (Goal/Manager tiles). :) But that's okay! Now player (and tiles) communicate smoother with goals for their win/lose/tie conditions!

- Win states
- Lose states
- Tie state

- Instant win/lose options
- Time mode (can be single or part of a set of goals)

- Each goal can have multiple states for win/lose
- Goal tiles can be combined (using Tile Manager) for any number of goal options

We look forward to showing you all the fun new things in Build a Game, next week!
Thank you!

notes.title: Week 2 Updates and News
notes.content:
Okay! Mondays are going to be our official update days!

It's the [u]second week[/u] (of announcements) and things are going great! First off, we want to thank each of you for all the work you are putting in to Build a Game Universe! We've had an excellent week of bug finding, game building and more!

Let's recap on what happened last week (Sept 11-18, 2016):

[b]- New Features and Tile Types![/b]
We put three new tile types in the default tileset and tileguy set! If you haven't seen them, be sure to check each one out. (We will have videos up explaining each type and how to use them). :)
[b]- Audio[/b] tile - allows you to place ambient and trigger-able audio in to your game!
[b]- Damage[/b] tile - allows you to place controllable hurt state tiles in game like spikes (with states for hitpoint and collider).
[b]- Dialog Bubble [/b]tile - let's you place in text boxes for players to say things!

[b]- Video Training[/b]
104 new videos on tiles were recorded last week (5 more hours of training content!)
The focus was on - Audio, Damage, Dialog, and all things Weapon!
Plus, anything that has been added to tiles (minor updates) has also been recorded for you.

[b]- Bugs[/b]
We have fixed, added and committed (resolved) over 80 bugs this week, helping to make Build a Game Universe more stable and developer friendly!

Release Notes: http://www.buildagameuniverse.com/release-notes/

Now let's take a moment to say thank you to some hard working, bug submitting testers this week!
- William Snavely
- Marcus
- Kiran (TwoGamingNL)
- gaminglund73
- Staale Kames
- Jim Tankersley
- Jonas Clagett
- Mario Nielsen
- igorrud95
(If we missed you, let us know) :)

Thank you all for excellent feedback, explanations, videos and images! Keep it coming! And let us know how best we can help you during the process. :)


[b]NEW THIS WEEK (Sept 19-26, 2016)[/b]

This week, we will release three new tilsets! Plus updates to the current ones (Changed some numbers, added a few extra tiles, etc).
1 - Tileguy Ortho Tileset - for map making!
2 - Tileset Camera Default (for video tutorials)
3 - Tileset Character Default extended (multiple character type examples - for video tutorials)


[b]- New - Video Training![/b]
[b]104 videos[/b] were recorded last week, and this week we will process those files and put them online for you!
Also, we have more recording scheduled for the week (camera, player and editor) and will get those processed and online when they are finished!

Be sure to check out all the Build a Game training videos at:
[b]Learn - Build a Game[/b]
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLTLXTizBX5u8KciEE4Rk_0ily-BAc-cN6
[b]Learn - Tile Properties[/b]
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLTLXTizBX5u8J6E8l1OvdaHCJLH65ICaq


[b]- New - Known Bugs List :|[/b]
So, the known bugs is a new spot (rollout) for you! We thought it might be helpful to see what is on our current list of bugs.
We've placed it on our release notes page under it's own heading -> Known Bugs: http://www.buildagameuniverse.com/release-notes/
These are just the ones we've found during our beta testing, video recording, and ones you've sent in.
As we get them done, they'll be added to the fixed list (release notes)! :)


[b]- Reminder - Silver Coin Allowance![/b]
Don't forget (or if you're new this week), you have a [b]Build a Game Silver Coin Allowance[/b] during our beta testing phase! Each week, you should notice [b]1,000 silver coins[/b] deposited into your account. :) Be sure to buy tiles, buy games, and have an excellent week of testing!

We are super excited about how things are going with Build a Game Universe beta. We know there's more work ahead, but with your help and this amazing community growing around us, we're going to do great!

You all are wonderful motivators and we sincerely appreciate your time and feedback! :)

Thank you!
Chad - Nathan - Eric
